lens: synthetic ownership, scoped reset and native recovery
scope: Debug standalone and internal Lab reset; synthetic Simulator proof

resolved_findings.finding: Broad Demo reset deleted a co-located Recordings directory and global stop requests without proving Demo ownership.
resolved_findings.correction: Admit only unchanged catalog-derived Demo state; preserve originals, ownership and global requests.
resolved_findings.proof: Real-file/media preservation and mixed/edited-state rejection checks.

resolved_findings.finding: A lost receipt could lead a repeated reset to clear work created afterward.
resolved_findings.correction: Atomic replacement carries original operation identity; retry only reconciles it.
resolved_findings.proof: Lost-receipt relaunch with subsequently created work preserved.

resolved_findings.finding: Completed reset history was unreachable from the restored Welcome screen.
resolved_findings.correction: Welcome exposes saved Demo reset history.
resolved_findings.proof: Native Chinese relaunch opens the same operation receipt.

limits: Server-created empty workspace, Web batches and broader controlled trials remain separate work.
No physical-device protection or assistive-technology user-comprehension claim.
Existing redundant English trust footer remains in Chinese standalone Welcome.
No TestFlight or production publication; full Lab goal remains active.
